### REQ-015: WiFi reconnection must never give up

## Requirement

`WiFiManager::startReconnectTimer()` (`net/wifi_manager.cpp:201-214`) stops scheduling reconnect attempts after `CONFIG_THERMO_WIFI_MAX_RETRY` (default 10) tries at `CONFIG_THERMO_WIFI_RECONNECT_INTERVAL` (default 5 s). `retryCount_` is only reset on a successful IP. Any AP outage longer than ~50 s therefore leaves the device **permanently offline until power-cycled**. The legacy firmware (`src/main.cpp:83-98`, `KeepWiFiConnected()`) retried WiFi and MQTT forever — this is a migration regression and the top availability risk for a building-wide fleet.

Fix: retry indefinitely; use the attempt counter only for exponential backoff (e.g. 5 s doubling to a 60–120 s cap) to avoid hammering the AP. Log a warning at each backoff step.

See finding F-3 in `doc/reports/2026-07-02_migration_code_review.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

```yaml acceptance
- id: AC1
  text: "Device reconnects automatically after an AP outage longer than `MAX_RETRY × interval` (test: disable AP for 5+ minutes, re-enable, device rejoins without reset) — *pending, no board attached 2026-07-04*"
  test: ""
  status: pending
- id: AC2
  text: "Backoff capped (5 s doubling to 120 s cap — no faster than 1 attempt/s, no slower than 1 attempt/2 min)"
  test: ""
  status: passed
- id: AC3
  text: "MQTT reconnects automatically after WiFi returns (existing esp-mqtt auto-reconnect verified end-to-end) — *pending, no board attached 2026-07-04*"
  test: ""
  status: pending
- id: AC4
  text: "Kconfig option semantics updated or removed (`THERMO_WIFI_MAX_RETRY` removed; reconnect interval help text documents backoff)"
  test: ""
  status: passed
```

## Notes

Heating control continues offline (PID keeps running on local sensors), so the only loss during outage is reporting/commands — but only if reconnection eventually succeeds.
